method: Domain is the authoritative dedupe key (lowercased, leading www. stripped) against known_keys.json dkeys + contacts_enrich_list.json domains. A row whose normalized NAME matches the dedupe authority but whose DOMAIN does not is kept as net-new and flagged NAME_MATCH_REVIEW - generic trade names (Standard Electric, American Electric Company, Preferred Electric) collide across genuinely distinct firms, so name-only suppression would drop real coverage. Descriptions are stored in full, never truncated.
